capabilities.name: category-aggregate
capabilities.description: Read the m_provision_category aggregate (id, categoryName, categoryDescription) by its primary key, as returned by GET /v1/provisioningcategory.
capabilities.evidence: Capture CAT-00 under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the four category rows (1 STANDARD, 2 SUB-STANDARD, 3 DOUBTFUL, 4 LOSS), each with a non-empty categoryDescription.

seams.name: provisioning-category-read
seams.description: GET /v1/provisioningcategory on the running Fineract server (Path B), tenant gerege: the m_provision_category aggregate rows.

note: Provisioning parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the provisioning-category-read seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Exactly one capability is graded: the category aggregate read. The reserve-amount arithmetic (PercentageOf/GenerateReserveEntries), the age-band match (Matches/ReserveRate) and the overlap invariant (Overlaps/ValidateRange) are NOT in the graded domain because the gerege tenant holds zero provisioning criteria, zero loan-product mappings, zero loans and zero provisioning entries: the running oracle produced no reserve amount, matched band or overlap refusal to transcribe, and creating one would write to the tenant (forbidden).
